song_craft: Shine-and-diving song (7v): varied shine → outcast dived → graded between → shared-split → held making → threaded return → cut-open. Stain and shine in one breath throughout.

lines: of knowings sundered — for the knower makes varied shine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kramo yo deśakālātmā bhedaprāṇas | sa saṃvidām vicchedād eṣa vijñātur vicitrābhāsatākṛtaḥ

purity of outcast things — in I-ness — immersion.

lines: Stain too of the sunken — no heart-rest so —
